name: Central Iowa pilot
coverage: Exploratory pilot for agricultural locations in and near Polk, Story, Boone, Dallas, and Jasper counties; this bounding box is only an app gate, not a soil-survey boundary.

demoPoint.label: Synthetic demonstration coordinate near Ames; not a verified farm field

normalRotations.note: Common row-crop baseline, not a recommendation for a particular field.
Diversified rotation investigated in Upper Midwest research; market, livestock, equipment, and multi-year commitments require local review.

climateRisks.risk: Heavy rainfall, ponding, flooding, and erosion

winter-wheat.harvest: following summer if grown for grain

cereal-rye.harvest: normally terminated in spring when used as cover

limitations: Seasons are broad windows, not field planting dates. State-level crop acreage does not prove a crop is suitable at a given point. A local agronomist must review any proposed sequence.
